_disclaimer: All records below are either (a) well-established public-knowledge reference alleles used purely as teaching examples, never real patient data, or (b) explicitly synthetic fixtures invented to illustrate a documented statistical pattern from the cited literature (see the Data and citations table in the source prototype's README on branch feature/deltagene-prototype, and 'Honest limits' in this repo's README). None of this file represents a real patient, a real ClinVar accession number, or real-world diagnostic performance.
_source: Ported from feature/deltagene-prototype deltagene/data/sample_variants.json. Only the HBB entry is carried; the DEMO1/DEMO2 synthetic fixtures are for genes this repo does not model and live inline in tests, labelled synthetic-illustrative.
_limitation: acmgInputs are the source prototype's single-field approximations, not curated evidence. priorClassification simulates the call already on record; it is not a live ClinVar query.

variants.note: The well-known public-domain beta-globin missense variant that causes sickle haemoglobin (HbS); used here only as a canonical, pedagogically-clear example of a pathogenic call feeding into a real approved therapy (see therapy_table.json).
